summary: The base's supply hub. It turns each loaded truck into credits, produces more trucks and refills drone crews that wait beside it. It has no weapon, so keep it behind the line.

sections.title: Produce supply trucks
sections.how: Select the supply center, open the Build tab and press Supply truck.
sections.body: Each truck leaves the center ready to harvest. The first one arrives free when the center finishes, so a new center starts earning at once. Queue another when the old trucks are far away.

sections.title: Receive supply loads
sections.how: There is no drop-off order: a loaded truck drives back to the nearest completed supply center and unloads by itself.
sections.body: The cargo becomes credits when unloading finishes, and the truck heads back to its depot. A truck chooses the nearest completed supply center, so build one close to the depots you work. If the center is destroyed, trucks look for another; with none left they wait.

sections.title: Refill drone crews
sections.how: Park an FPV team beside the supply center; no order is needed.
sections.body: Drone charges are ammunition: a crew with empty pips cannot launch. While a crew short of charges stays in range, one charge comes back after a wait. Leaving the area resets the clock. A supply truck or barracks does the same job in the field.

sections.title: Rally point
sections.how: Select the supply center, press Rally point and left-click the ground.
sections.body: Produced trucks drive to the rally point. Without one they start harvesting the nearest depot on their own. Changing the point only affects trucks produced afterwards, and the marker shows while the center is selected.

sections.title: Repair with a dozer
sections.how: Select a dozer and left-click the damaged supply center.
sections.body: The dozer drives to the center and restores it until it is whole. The work costs half the build price as the health comes back, and only one dozer works on a building at a time. If the credits run out, the repair stops and the dozer goes idle.

sections.title: Sell
sections.how: Select the supply center and press Sell twice.
sections.body: It sells for half its price and disappears at once. Any truck in its queue is cancelled and refunded in full. Selling your last building loses the match.

strong: Funding an army near the depots
Keeping drone crews in the fight
tips: Build it close to the depots your trucks work: every truck unloads at the nearest completed supply center.
The first truck is free when the center finishes, so a new center starts earning at once.
Park an FPV team beside it between fights so its charges are full when the drones are needed.
Set a rally point toward the front for new trucks, or leave it clear so they start harvesting at once.
Keep a dozer nearby: the center cannot repair itself.
